high.label: High
high.description: Serious harm to users or third parties.

foundational_governance.label: Foundational governance
foundational_governance.description: Published methodology, principles or framework that frames the organization's governance.

core_governance.label: Core governance
core_governance.description: Policy, statement or commitment. Intent without execution proof.

operational_evidence.label: Operational evidence
operational_evidence.description: Process, control, metric or dated record. Execution evidence.

external_validation.label: External validation
external_validation.description: Independent audit, certification or regulatory filing.

none.label: None
none.description: Policy document only; no execution signals found.

verified.label: Verified
verified.description: Third-party verified artefact or dated quantified outcome.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.description: Passed every check; usable by the rules engine.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Failed a check; stored for audit and never used.

low.label: Low
low.description: Reported concerns in lower-confidence sources. Confidence is moderated; the level is unchanged.

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.description: A reported gap between stated commitments and observed practice.

high.label: High
high.description: A reported active legal or regulatory proceeding or a reported AI harm event.

critical.label: Critical
critical.description: A regulatory order or enforcement action in a verified public record.

under_investigation.label: Under investigation
under_investigation.description: Being looked into by the organization or an authority.

substantiated.label: Substantiated
substantiated.description: Confirmed by an authoritative source or a reviewer.

dismissed.label: Dismissed
dismissed.description: Found not to be an incident of this organization.

affiliate.label: Affiliate
affiliate.description: Published by a parent, subsidiary or controlled entity.

commissioned.label: Commissioned
commissioned.description: Independent party paid by the organization, for example an engaged auditor.

independent.label: Independent
independent.description: No commercial relationship with the organization.

evaluating.label: Evaluating
evaluating.description: Snapshot frozen; findings and rules running.

awaiting_review.label: Awaiting review
awaiting_review.description: A review trigger fired (certification, material contradiction, unresolved incident, borderline confidence).

completed_unverified.label: Completed (unverified)
completed_unverified.description: Result final, no human sign-off required or given.

high.label: High
high.description: Higher consequence if absent; Phase 6 weight 1.2 or above.

none.label: None
none.description: Nothing beyond a mention, title or metadata.

stated_commitment.label: Stated commitment
stated_commitment.description: The organization says it does or will do this. A quoted policy or statement.

specified_control.label: Specified control
specified_control.description: A named control with an owner and a measurable threshold.

documented_execution.label: Documented execution
documented_execution.description: Dated results showing the control ran. Self-reported counts here.

independently_verified.label: Independently verified
independently_verified.description: An independent party or regulator confirms the outcome (IC-07).

subsidiary.label: Subsidiary
subsidiary.description: The child is owned by the parent.

acquired.label: Acquired
acquired.description: The child was acquired by the parent.

access_limited.label: Access limited
access_limited.description: Primary sources unavailable above a threshold share of criteria.

insufficient_evidence.label: Insufficient evidence
insufficient_evidence.description: Too few criteria observed to compute a defensible score.

governance_baseline.label: Governance baseline
governance_baseline.description: Raw score is 0 but high- or medium-strength signals exist.

confidence_too_low.label: Confidence too low
confidence_too_low.description: Score computed but confidence below the certification minimum.

certification_not_yet_achieved.label: Certification not yet achieved
certification_not_yet_achieved.description: Score and confidence computed; a gate failed or no reviewer has signed.

hai_certified.label: HAI certified
hai_certified.description: All gates pass and a signed certification decision exists.

TRU.description: Users can rely on the organization's AI to behave as described and in their interest.

ACC.label: Accountability
ACC.description: Named people own AI outcomes, correct failures and oversee the practice.

PUR.label: Purpose
PUR.description: The organization states why it uses AI and acts in line with that purpose.

SAF.label: Safety
SAF.description: Risks are assessed and mitigated, users are protected and long-term harms are considered.

TRN.label: Transparency
TRN.description: The organization explains its AI, discloses its data practices and communicates honestly.

IMP.label: Impact
IMP.description: AI produces measurable, shared and lasting benefit for people.

supports.label: Supports
supports.description: The span is evidence that the target meets or advances the criterion.

contradicts.label: Contradicts
contradicts.description: The span is evidence against the target on this criterion (failed test, incident, retraction).

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.description: The span is relevant context but argues neither way.

independent_audit.label: Independent audit
independent_audit.description: An audit firm engaged by the organization.

org_disclosure.label: Organization disclosure
org_disclosure.description: The organization's own website, reports and model cards.

archive.label: Web archive
archive.description: An archived copy of a page; independence follows the archived publisher.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Accept the subject as it stands.

dismiss.label: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Mark an incident as not this organization's.

contradiction.label: Contradiction
contradiction.description: Resolve contradictory evidence on a criterion.

confidence.label: Borderline confidence
confidence.description: Confirm or reject a borderline result.

applicability.label: Applicability
applicability.description: Confirm a not-applicable or review effect.

cap.label: Cap
cap.description: Limits a level or score from above.

gate.label: Gate
gate.description: Decides a state or routes to review.

adjustment.label: Adjustment
adjustment.description: Moves a level up or down.

fail.label: Fail
fail.description: The control did not meet its threshold.

inconclusive.label: Inconclusive
inconclusive.description: The test did not produce a usable result.

Organization.label: Organization
Organization.description: The rated organization. External identifiers are stored only when verified against the submitted domain.

OrganizationRelation.label: OrganizationRelation
OrganizationRelation.description: Parent, subsidiary, affiliate or acquisition links between organizations. Drives independence.

AISystem.label: AISystem
AISystem.description: An AI system operated by the organization. Optional in v1 (decision D6); evidence may link to the organization directly.

Claim.label: Claim
Claim.description: An assertion the organization makes about itself. A claim is never evidence of its own truth. Uploads enter as claims.

Control.label: Control
Control.description: A governance mechanism protecting a system or the organization.

TestOutcome.label: TestOutcome
TestOutcome.description: A point-in-time test of a control. A failed test is kept and shown, never dropped.

Incident.label: Incident
Incident.description: One row per real-world event regardless of article count. News reports attach as evidence (AT-04).

Remediation.label: Remediation
Remediation.description: An action taken to fix an incident. Closure counts as independently verified only with an independent verifier.

Publisher.label: Publisher
Publisher.description: Who published a source document. org_id is set when the publisher is the rated organization or an affiliate.

Connector.label: Connector
Connector.description: A configured evidence source. A new source is a configuration row, not an ontology change.

ConnectorRun.label: ConnectorRun
ConnectorRun.description: Proof that a fetch was attempted for an assessment and how it ended (IC-16). Recorded even when nothing came back.

SourceDocument.label: SourceDocument
SourceDocument.description: A frozen copy of a fetched or uploaded document with its hash, dates and rights. A re-fetch with a different hash is a new row.

SourceCluster.label: SourceCluster
SourceCluster.description: Groups syndicated or near-duplicate documents so they count once for independence and confidence (IC-09).

EvidenceSpan.label: EvidenceSpan
EvidenceSpan.description: The citable unit. The exact quote with character offsets into the stored text (IC-03).

EvidenceLink.label: EvidenceLink
EvidenceLink.description: The only bridge from evidence to a score. One span, one target, one criterion, six separate judgments (spec section 6).

MethodologyVersion.label: MethodologyVersion
MethodologyVersion.description: A released methodology. Only a signed Humaital change record creates a new version.

Criterion.label: Criterion
Criterion.description: One of the twenty criteria. Codes are permanent; retired codes are never reused.

LevelDescriptor.label: LevelDescriptor
LevelDescriptor.description: What each level 1 to 5 means for one criterion, and the maturity rung it requires (decision D1).

CriterionApplicability.label: CriterionApplicability
CriterionApplicability.description: When a criterion does not apply or must be reviewed (decision D5).

Rule.label: Rule
Rule.description: One rule of a ruleset, referenced by code so traces can name it.

Assessment.label: Assessment
Assessment.description: One scoring run. Pins every version (IC-18). lifecycle_state follows spec section 8.1.

EvidenceSnapshot.label: EvidenceSnapshot
EvidenceSnapshot.description: Frozen copy of every link's judgment columns, incident states and version pins. The rules engine reads only this (AT-07).

CriterionFinding.label: CriterionFinding
CriterionFinding.description: LLM or heuristic output. Advisory only. Rejected findings are stored for audit and never used (IC-05).

CriterionDecision.label: CriterionDecision
CriterionDecision.description: Rules-engine output. The only source of criterion levels. Every decision lists the rules that ran (IC-14).

AssessmentResult.label: AssessmentResult
AssessmentResult.description: The HAI Score, confidence and effectiveness plus the outcome status set only by the rules engine (AT-10).

CertificationDecision.label: CertificationDecision
CertificationDecision.description: Signed by a named reviewer. Never written by the LLM, the engine or the browser (IC-13).

Review.label: Review
Review.description: A human decision on an incident, contradiction, borderline confidence, finding, link, appeal or certification. Always with a reason.

AuditEvent.label: AuditEvent
AuditEvent.description: Append-only, hash-chained record of every decision-bearing write (AT-15).

integrity_constraints.IC-01: evidence_links.polarity cannot be updated after insert.
integrity_constraints.IC-02: source_documents, evidence_spans, criterion_decisions, audit_events are insert-only.
integrity_constraints.IC-03: An evidence span's quote must match the stored snapshot at its character offsets.
integrity_constraints.IC-04: A criterion finding may cite only span and link ids inside its assessment's evidence snapshot.
integrity_constraints.IC-05: A finding with a missing or unknown criterion_code, or no citations for a proposed level above 1, is rejected.
integrity_constraints.IC-06: maturity_rung above stated_commitment requires a span with non-empty quoted text, not metadata only.
integrity_constraints.IC-07: maturity_rung independently_verified requires independence independent or regulator.
integrity_constraints.IC-08: A link contributes only to the criterion_code it names. No cross-criterion or global promotion.
integrity_constraints.IC-09: Documents in one source cluster count once for independence and confidence.
integrity_constraints.IC-10: One canonical incident per canonical_event_key; at most one score adjustment per incident per assessment.
integrity_constraints.IC-11: Incidents in alleged or under_investigation create a review, never an automatic adjustment.
integrity_constraints.IC-12: criterion_decisions, assessment_results and certification_decisions are writable only by the rules-engine and reviewer roles.
integrity_constraints.IC-13: hai_certified requires a signed certification_decisions row with a reviewer.
integrity_constraints.IC-14: Every criterion_decision lists at least one applied rule code.
integrity_constraints.IC-15: coverage_state unavailable requires at least one failed or blocked connector_run.
integrity_constraints.IC-16: No source may be reported as collected unless a connector_run with succeeded exists for it.
integrity_constraints.IC-17: Crawled text is stored as data only and never concatenated into system instructions.
integrity_constraints.IC-18: Each assessment pins ontology, methodology, ruleset, prompt and model versions; none may be null.

coverage_wording.observed: Assessed from admissible evidence. The level and its evidence are shown.
coverage_wording.missing: Sources were searched and nothing relevant was found. This is not proof of absence.
coverage_wording.unavailable: Sources could not be reached. This is an access limitation, not a governance gap. Excluded from the score.
coverage_wording.not_applicable: This criterion does not apply to the organization under the stated rule. Excluded from the score.
coverage_wording.not_tested: A control is documented but its operation is unconfirmed.
coverage_wording.failed: Execution evidence shows the control did not work. The failed result and its date are shown.
coverage_wording.contradictory: Supporting and contradicting evidence were both admissible. Both sides are shown and the criterion was routed to review.
